parse.title: Fairy Ruler
parse.text:
Overview

Fairy Ruler is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable through summons.

Evolving

Fairy Ruler can evolve into Fairy Ruler (Sloth) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Fairy Ruler
x12 Demonic Chalice
x12 Demonic Horn
x6 Fairy Petals
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Fairy Ruler (Sloth)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
